purpose: Teach: 霊魂/病床/擬似/昇華/接合/減免/詰め込ん/付託

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、宗教における霊魂の概念を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you addressed the concept of the soul in religion in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, professional acknowledgment. Steady gaze. Opens a door for the student to elaborate. Not testing—genuinely interested in what she discovered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、病床にあった作家の作品を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on a writer's work from their time of illness.
lines.style: Direct and clear, with quiet pride underneath. Eyes meet hers. No defensiveness—just stating what she did and meaning it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 擬似科学の批判を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You took on the critique of pseudoscience in your research as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Nods slightly, reflecting on the work. Warm curiosity—she's drawing connections, not quizzing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、苦悩を芸術へ昇華した作家を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined how the writer transformed suffering into art.
lines.style: Firm and sincere. Leans slightly forward on this point—it mattered to her. No apology in the tone, just conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織と組織の接合関係史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the history of how organizations intersect and merge.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning in slightly. Voice lifts with genuine interest. She's following Sakura's path and impressed by the scope of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の減免政策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, through the lens of wartime exemption policies.
lines.style: Steady and precise. Brief—she's said what needed saying. Confident in her choice of focus without overselling it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 過剰に詰め込んだ教育課程の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in this final piece, you examined the research on overcrowded curricula.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower pace. Respect in her voice for the scope. A small smile—she sees what Sakura is building across these papers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、議会への付託案件の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, through cases referred to the Diet for deliberation.
lines.style: Final statement with understated strength. Breath settles. She's completed something. Meets Asuka's eyes—not asking permission, but offering clarity.
